Nakibahagi si Mayor Joy Belmonte sa kick-off ceremony ng Fire Prevention Month ngayong Marso na pinangasiwaan ng Quezon City Fire District (QCFD) sa Risen Garden ng City Hall.

Hinimok ni Mayor Joy ang mga kawani ng QCFD na ipagpatuloy ang kanilang pagiging tapat sa trabaho, maagap na aksyon sa sunog, at pagwaksi ang anumang uri ng kurapsyon sa kanilang hanay.

Kasama sa programa sina City Administrator Mike Alimurung, DILG-QC Director Manny Borromeo, QCFD Marshal FSSupt. Roberto Samillano Jr., QCFD Fire Chief Inspector Marvin Mari, QCPD Director PBGEN. Randy Glenn Silvio, DRRMO head Bianca Perez, at Councilor Egay Yap.

Seventy-five years ago, when freedom on the Korean Peninsula hung by a thread, the first Asian nation to extend a hand was the Philippines. General Carlos P. Romulo, then President of the United Nations General Assembly, helped rally international support—guided by the profound conviction that freedom is indivisible, and that a blow dealt to liberty in one corner of the globe is a strike against the conscience of all mankind—and persuaded his government to make a historic decision: to dispatch Asia’s first combat troops to Korea.
